caption: The drawing depicts a piece of wooden furniture that appears to be a secretary desk with two main sections. The lower section consists of a rectangular desk surface that can fold down, revealing several small compartments and drawers. There is a large central drawer with two brass handles, supported by four straight legs with subtle gold accents at the bottom and top. The upper section comprises two cabinet doors, each with an oval panel displaying a yellow-gold classical figure set against a black background. Above these doors, the structure has a curved top with three more oval panels; each contains a similar figure in yellow-gold on a black background. The wood is illustrated with a brown grain pattern, and the panels on the furniture are outlined by thin gold borders. The entire design is drawn against a plain off-white background, and a signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Cabinet Top Desk
